correctness.rationale: Verified the finite-field intersection of roots of X^(2^a-1)+1 and (1+X)^(2^b-1)+1 and Frobenius multiplicities, yielding gcd H_g^r, H_g=(X^(2^g-1)+1)/(X+1). Confirmed individual orders L via primitive roots and nilpotent H_g-adic valuation, including r=1 and g=1. The S3 actions lambda->lambda^-1 and lambda->1+lambda constrain semisimple relations; for g>=4 even a polynomial degree bound excludes the exceptional diagonal; for g=2 an explicit H2-adic lowest-term unit argument leaves exactly three. The coefficient-of-highest-degree pairing in F2[X]/H_g^r is nondegenerate, furnishing one faithful-orbit witness rather than an unsupported genericity assumption. Reconstructed 15 bounded independent GF2 kernel/group cases; all-parameter conclusions follow from the polynomial proof.

value.rationale: Provides the explicit full finite group action beyond scalar periodic point counts: exactly which translations act trivially and a maximal orbit realized in each natural Mersenne-power torus, including an exceptional degree-two case.

final_claim: For Ledrappier three-dot torus periods m=2^u(2^a-1), n=2^v(2^b-1), g=gcd(a,b), r=2^min(u,v), L=r(2^g-1), the dual is F2[X]/H_g^r; g=1 gives the zero group. For g>=2 the translation generator orders are L, and the joint kernel on (Z/L)^2 is trivial for g>=3 and the order-three diagonal {(0,0),(r,r),(2r,2r)} for g=2. Some configuration realizes the full faithful orbit L^2 or L^2/3.
limitations: Only periods of the specified Mersenne times powers-of-two form; not all toroidal periods or complete orbit-size distributions.
